name: Document Hash Verification via QR Code
objective: Replace QR-based document verification with SHA-256 hash verification — encode content hash in QR URL, server re-computes and compares hashes to prove data integrity
exit_criteria: lib/document-hash.ts canonical serialization + SHA-256 functions for quotation and invoice data
SQL migration adds content_hash column to quotations and invoices tables
PDF generator encodes hash in QR URL as ?h={sha256_hex}
PDF generator saves hash to DB at generation time
Verify API accepts hash from QR, recomputes from DB, compares
Verify API backward compatible — missing ?h= uses old manual-entry flow
Verify page auto-verifies from QR hash, shows match/mismatch status
Verify page backward compatible — no hash shows manual number entry
All labels from site-content.ts with en/id, no hardcoded text
